name: goo1-wp-claude-bridge
description: WordPress site management via REST API for Claude AI

tools.name: wp_list_posts
tools.description: List WordPress posts, pages, or custom post types with filtering and pagination.

post_type.description: Post type: post, page, or any custom post type slug

status.description: Post status: publish, draft, pending, private, trash, any

tools.name: wp_get_post
tools.description: Get a single post/page with full content and taxonomy data. Post meta is NOT included by default (only `meta_keys`, the list of meta names); pass include_meta=true or meta_keys to get values. Secret-looking meta is redacted.

include_meta.description: Include all post meta values (can be large, e.g. _elementor_data).

meta_keys.description: Comma-separated meta keys to include (implies include_meta).

unredacted.description: Return secrets unredacted. Only works if an administrator granted 'Secrets in clear text' to this key/connection; otherwise ignored. Flagged in the audit log.

tools.name: wp_create_post
tools.description: Create a new post, page, or custom post type entry. Returns a slim summary (id, status, link …); pass return_full=true for the full post. Content is stored like in the editor: HTML is only filtered if the run-as user lacks unfiltered_html.

return_full.description: Return the full post instead of a summary.

tools.name: wp_update_post
tools.description: Update an existing post/page. Only send fields you want to change. Returns a slim summary (id, status, link …); pass return_full=true for the full post. Content is stored like in the editor: HTML is only filtered if the run-as user lacks unfiltered_html.

return_full.description: Return the full post instead of a summary.

tools.name: wp_delete_post
tools.description: Trash or permanently delete a post. Set force=true to skip trash.

tools.name: wp_list_post_types
tools.description: List all registered post types with their properties and taxonomy associations.

tools.name: wp_list_taxonomies
tools.description: List all registered taxonomies.

tools.name: wp_list_terms
tools.description: List terms for a taxonomy (categories, tags, custom).

tools.name: wp_get_term
tools.description: Get a single term.

tools.name: wp_create_term
tools.description: Create a new taxonomy term.

tools.name: wp_update_term
tools.description: Update a term (name, slug, description, parent, meta).

tools.name: wp_delete_term
tools.description: Delete a term.

tools.name: wp_list_media
tools.description: List media library attachments.

tools.name: wp_upload_media
tools.description: Upload a file to the WordPress media library. PREFERRED: pass `url` (a single http/https URL or an array of URLs) and WordPress downloads the file(s) server-side — no large base64 payload travels through the conversation, which saves a lot of tokens. Alternatively pass `base64` + `filename` as a fallback (a leading data:*;base64, prefix is stripped automatically). Optional: attach to a post, set as featured image, title/alt/caption/description, author, date, custom meta, dedupe, overwrite, MIME allow-list and subsize control.

url.description: Remote http/https URL, or array of URLs, that WordPress downloads itself. Preferred over base64. A single URL returns one media object; an array returns { items, count }.

base64.description: Base64-encoded file content (fallback; large files cost many tokens). A data:*;base64, prefix is stripped automatically.

filename.description: Filename incl. extension. Required for base64. For URLs it is derived from the URL (and the extension sniffed) when omitted.

mime_type.description: Force the MIME type — useful for extensionless URLs.

attach_to_post.description: Parent post/page ID to attach the media to.

set_as_featured.description: Set the uploaded image as the featured image of attach_to_post.

author.description: User ID to record as the attachment author.

meta.description: Additional attachment post-meta as key/value pairs.

dedupe.description: Reuse an existing attachment instead of creating a duplicate.

dedupe_by.description: How to detect a duplicate: by the original source URL (default) or by filename.

overwrite_existing.description: Delete a prior attachment with the same filename before uploading.

generate_subsizes.description: Generate intermediate image sizes. Automatically skipped for very large images (~>25 MP or >40 MB) unless force_subsizes is set.

force_subsizes.description: Force subsize generation even for very large images.

max_filesize.description: Reject files larger than this many bytes.

tools.name: wp_get_media
tools.description: Get a single media attachment including its metadata and available image sizes.

tools.name: wp_update_media
tools.description: Update a media attachment's fields (title, caption, description, alt text).

tools.name: wp_delete_media
tools.description: Delete a media attachment. force defaults to true (skips trash and removes the files).

tools.name: wp_list_comments
tools.description: List comments with filtering by post, status, and type.

tools.name: wp_get_comment
tools.description: Get a single comment.

tools.name: wp_create_comment
tools.description: Create a new comment on a post.

tools.name: wp_update_comment
tools.description: Update a comment (content, status: 0/1/spam/trash, author_name, author_email, meta).

tools.name: wp_delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment (trash, or permanently with force=true).

tools.name: wp_list_users
tools.description: List WordPress users with role and search filtering.

tools.name: wp_get_user
tools.description: Get detailed user info including capabilities and meta.

unredacted.description: Return secrets unredacted. Only works if an administrator granted 'Secrets in clear text' to this key/connection; otherwise ignored. Flagged in the audit log.

tools.name: wp_create_user
tools.description: Create a new WordPress user.

tools.name: wp_update_user
tools.description: Update a user (email, display_name, first_name, last_name, url, description, password, role, meta).

tools.name: wp_delete_user
tools.description: Delete a user. Pass reassign (user ID) to keep their content.

tools.name: wp_list_roles
tools.description: List all WordPress roles with capabilities and user counts.

tools.name: wp_get_options
tools.description: Read options by name. Values of secret-bearing keys (passwords, API/S3 keys, tokens, licence keys) are returned as "[redacted]" unless unredacted is allowed. Bridge credentials are never returned.

unredacted.description: Return secrets unredacted. Only works if an administrator granted 'Secrets in clear text' to this key/connection; otherwise ignored. Flagged in the audit log.

tools.name: wp_update_options
tools.description: Create/update options (object of name→value). "[redacted]" placeholders inside a value keep the stored secret, so a value read with wp_get_options can be written back safely. Claude Bridge's own settings (goo1_mcp_*) cannot be changed.

options.description: Key-value pairs of options to set

tools.name: wp_list_all_options
tools.description: List all autoloaded options, or search options by name.

unredacted.description: Return secrets unredacted. Only works if an administrator granted 'Secrets in clear text' to this key/connection; otherwise ignored. Flagged in the audit log.

tools.name: wp_delete_option
tools.description: Delete an option (Claude Bridge settings and secret-bearing options are protected).

tools.name: wp_list_plugins
tools.description: List all installed plugins with their activation status.

tools.name: wp_activate_plugin
tools.description: Activate an installed plugin by folder slug (e.g. 'worker') or plugin file (e.g. 'worker/init.php').

slug.description: Plugin directory name or full file path

tools.name: wp_deactivate_plugin
tools.description: Deactivate a plugin.

tools.name: wp_list_updates
tools.description: Available WordPress core, plugin, theme and translation updates. refresh=true checks wordpress.org now.

tools.name: wp_install_plugin
tools.description: Install a plugin from wordpress.org (slug, e.g. 'updraftplus', 'worker', 'wordfence') or from any ZIP URL. activate=true activates it. Already installed → error unless overwrite=true (reinstall/downgrade).

tools.name: wp_update_plugin
tools.description: Update an installed plugin to the latest available version (keeps it active). Tip: update Elementor before Hello Elementor.

tools.name: wp_delete_plugin
tools.description: Delete an inactive plugin's files.

tools.name: wp_list_themes
tools.description: List all installed themes with their status.

tools.name: wp_activate_theme
tools.description: Switch the active theme.

tools.name: wp_install_theme
tools.description: Install a theme from wordpress.org (slug) or any ZIP URL (overwrite=true to reinstall).

tools.name: wp_update_theme
tools.description: Update an installed theme to the latest available version.

tools.name: wp_delete_theme
tools.description: Delete an installed, inactive theme.

tools.name: wp_list_menus
tools.description: List all navigation menus.

tools.name: wp_get_menu
tools.description: Get a menu with all its items.

tools.name: wp_create_menu
tools.description: Create a navigation menu, optionally assigned to a theme location.

tools.name: wp_delete_menu
tools.description: Delete a navigation menu.

tools.name: wp_set_menu_items
tools.description: REPLACE all items of a menu. Each item: title, type (custom|post_type|taxonomy), url (custom), object + object_id (post/page/term), parent_index (nest under the item at that position of this list), target, classes. For single items use wp_rest_request on /wp/v2/menu-items.

tools.name: wp_list_menu_locations
tools.description: List theme menu locations and the menu assigned to each.

tools.name: wp_db_query
tools.description: Execute a SQL query against the WordPress database (needs full scope). SELECT/SHOW/DESCRIBE/EXPLAIN return rows with best-effort redaction (user_pass, password hashes, session tokens, secret option values …) unless unredacted is allowed. INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/REPLACE need db_write; writes run in a transaction and are rolled back if they touch Claude Bridge settings. DROP/ALTER/CREATE/TRUNCATE/RENAME/GRANT/REVOKE are always blocked; LOAD_FILE/INTO OUTFILE/DUMPFILE/LOAD DATA need the 'SQL file access' grant. Tip: use %s/%d placeholders.

sql.description: SQL query. Use %s, %d, %f placeholders for parameters.

unredacted.description: Return secrets unredacted. Only works if an administrator granted 'Secrets in clear text' to this key/connection; otherwise ignored. Flagged in the audit log.

tools.name: wp_db_tables
tools.description: List all database tables with size, engine, and row count info.

tools.name: wp_db_table_schema
tools.description: Describe a table's columns, types, keys, and indexes.

tools.name: wp_db_table_sample
tools.description: Get sample rows from a table.

unredacted.description: Return secrets unredacted. Only works if an administrator granted 'Secrets in clear text' to this key/connection; otherwise ignored. Flagged in the audit log.

tools.name: wp_site_health
tools.description: Get comprehensive site health info: WP/PHP/MySQL versions, debug state, memory, upload limits, active plugins count, constants, and more.

tools.name: wp_error_log
tools.description: Read the last N lines of the WordPress debug log.

tools.name: wp_list_cron
tools.description: List all scheduled WordPress cron events.

tools.name: wp_run_cron
tools.description: Run a scheduled cron hook now, with the arguments it was scheduled with (each distinct scheduled event runs once). Optionally restrict to one event via `args`.

args.description: Only run the scheduled event whose args equal this array.

tools.name: wp_list_hooks
tools.description: List registered WordPress actions and filters with callback counts.

tools.name: wp_get_hook
tools.description: Get detailed info about a specific hook including all registered callbacks.

tools.name: wp_list_transients
tools.description: List WordPress transients with expiration info.

tools.name: wp_delete_transient
tools.description: Delete a transient by name.

tools.name: wp_list_widgets
tools.description: List all widget areas (sidebars) and their active widgets.

tools.name: wp_rewrite_rules
tools.description: List all rewrite rules and the current permalink structure.

tools.name: wp_rest_request
tools.description: Call ANY other REST route of this site internally, as the run-as administrator (no nonce/cookie needed): e.g. /wp/v2/menu-items, /redirection/v1/redirect, /yoast/v1/…, /wc/v3/…. Needs full scope (also for GET, because it runs as an administrator). Response data is redacted and capped at max_bytes.

unredacted.description: Return secrets unredacted. Only works if an administrator granted 'Secrets in clear text' to this key/connection; otherwise ignored. Flagged in the audit log.

include_links.description: Keep HAL _links in the response (removed by default to save tokens).

tools.name: wp_rest_routes
tools.description: List REST namespaces, or the routes and methods of one namespace (namespace=wp/v2) or matching a search string.

tools.name: wp_flush_rewrite_rules
tools.description: Flush (regenerate) rewrite rules / permalinks.

tools.name: woo_list_products
tools.description: List WooCommerce products. Only available when WooCommerce is active.

tools.name: woo_get_product
tools.description: Get full WooCommerce product details.

tools.name: woo_update_product
tools.description: Update product name, price, stock, status, etc.

tools.name: woo_list_orders
tools.description: List WooCommerce orders with filtering.

tools.name: woo_get_order
tools.description: Get full order details including line items, billing, shipping, and notes.

tools.name: woo_update_order
tools.description: Update order status or customer note.

tools.name: woo_adjust_stock
tools.description: Adjust product stock quantity (set, increase, decrease).

tools.name: woo_sales_report
tools.description: Get sales summary for a period (orders, revenue, shipping, tax, refunds).

tools.name: woo_list_customers
tools.description: List WooCommerce customers with order count and total spent.

tools.name: woo_get_customer
tools.description: Get full customer details including billing and shipping addresses.

tools.name: elementor_get_data
tools.description: Get a post/page's parsed Elementor data (_elementor_data) plus edit mode, Elementor version, template type and page settings. Only available when Elementor is active.

tools.name: elementor_update_data
tools.description: Replace a post's Elementor data. Pass `data` as a JSON array of Elementor elements (or a JSON string). Handles wp_slash correctly (the classic Elementor save pitfall) and regenerates the post's CSS by default.

data.description: Elementor elements tree as an array, or a JSON string of it.

page_settings.description: Optional Elementor page settings to store.

regenerate_css.description: Regenerate this post's Elementor CSS after saving.

tools.name: elementor_find_widgets
tools.description: Return a compact list of all Elementor elements/widgets on a post (id, elType, widgetType, depth and a short text preview) instead of the full data blob — a token-saver for inspecting a page's structure. Optionally filter by widget_type.

widget_type.description: Only return widgets of this widgetType (e.g. 'heading', 'image').

tools.name: elementor_list_templates
tools.description: List Elementor library templates (page, section, container, widget, popup, header, footer, ...).

tools.name: elementor_get_kit
tools.description: Get the active Elementor kit id, title and global settings.

tools.name: elementor_regenerate_css
tools.description: Regenerate the Elementor CSS file for a single post/page.

tools.name: elementor_regenerate_all_css
tools.description: Clear and regenerate all Elementor CSS site-wide.
